name: packstruct
description: The shared /packs spec: one manifest, entry, and lifecycle contract for crashtest and poststruct packs - plus a zero-dependency lint CLI that kills broken pack manifests at author time.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node --test test/status.test.mjs test/refusal-matrix.test.mjs tests/ship-from-download.test.cjs
scripts.lint:docs: node scripts/check-docs-frontmatter.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-links.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-style.cjs && node scripts/check-jekyll-filters.cjs && node scripts/check-language.cjs
scripts.check: npm run lint:docs && node scripts/check-legal.cjs && npm run matrix:check && npm run lint:packs && npm run conform:packs
